title: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst: We need to add numbers at cornerback

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst: We need to add numbers at cornerback
sources.description: The Packers don't have a first-round pick on Thursday night, but General Manager Brian Gutekunst gave a little hint about what direction they'll be going on Friday and Saturday.
